# fjordrun_function_code (Data Source)

A function's saved inline code. Fails for code from GitHub.

## Example Usage

```terraform
variable "function_id" {
  type = string
}

data "fjordrun_function_code" "hello" {
  function_id = var.function_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `function_id` (String) Function ID.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Save time.
- `files` (Map of String) File contents by path.
- `id` (String) Identifier of this result.
- `paths` (List of String) File paths.
- `sha256` (String) Hash.
- `size_bytes` (Number) Size.
